item.title: UK government exempting itself from cyber law inspires little confidence
item.description:
📝 Given this threat landscape, why does the UK's flagship Cyber Security and Resilience (CSR) Bill exclude both central and local government. This plan will ostensibly hold government departments to equal security standards as the CSR bill. This suggests the government is considering specific legislation to shore up public sector security further down the line.
